title: Unique Ultra Welsh Blackberries Shepherds Pie
description: A traditional Welsh shepherd's pie with a twist, featuring blackberries and a low-calorie puff pastry crust, perfect for a post-workout meal. This dish is made with fatty and fluffy ingredients to provide sustained energy.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and carrots until tender.
Add the ground beef to the pan and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the frozen peas, salt, and pepper, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix the frozen blackberries with a little water to create a sauce.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the beef mixture into a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Pour the blackberry sauce over the beef mixture.
Place the puff pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with a little water and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the bamboo steamer in the oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
